title: Ringed-slice extension preserves exactness
statement: Let C be a category with object universe u and morphism universe v, J a Grothendieck topology, O a sheaf of commutative rings with values in universe max u v, and U an object. Write R for its underlying ring sheaf, and L for the direct-sum extension from R.over U-module sheaves followed by module sheafification, all module values in universe max u v. For every short complex S of R.over U-module sheaves, S.Exact implies imageSubobject (L.map S.f) = kernelSubobject (L.map S.g). The notions are those of [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf], [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification].

proof.text: Use the proved private concrete adjunction CategoryTheory.extensionSheafAdjunction of [new-localized-restriction-extension-exists] through a proof-only import all of WeilConjectures.Algebra.Homology.LocalizedRestrictionExtensionExists, for the concrete direct-sum extension followed by module sheafification. Restriction is additive sectionwise, so Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive makes L additive, and Adjunction.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits makes L preserve finite colimits.

Evaluation of a mono of module sheaves is monic, hence injective by ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective. The presheaf extension map is DirectSum.lmap; DirectSum.lmap_injective and PresheafOfModules.mono_of_injective show that it preserves monos. Mathlib already proves PreservesFiniteLimits for module sheafification, so the composite L preserves monos.

For a short exact complex T, map its cokernel cofork by L, using CokernelCofork.mapIsColimit. ShortComplex.exact_and_epi_g_iff_g_is_cokernel gives exactness and an epi, and preservation of monos gives the remaining short-exactness property. Functor.exact_tfae then implies preservation of every exact short complex. Finally apply ShortComplex.exact_iff_image_eq_kernel.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSliceExtension_preserves_exact
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v}) (U : C)
    (S : ShortComplex (ringedSiteModules.{max u v} (((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj O).over U)))
    (hS : S.Exact) :
    let R := (sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj O
    let L := extensionByZeroPresheaf.{max u v} R U ⋙
      PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{max u v} (𝟙 R.obj)
    imageSubobject (L.map S.f) = kernelSubobject (L.map S.g)
